lines.zh: 六条腿交错落地，蹄声很轻。
lines.en: Six hooves land in turn with a light sound.

lines.zh: 我头顶的冠脊在光里发亮。
lines.en: The crest on my head shines in the light.
I take the path through the wood.

lines.zh: 一步步，我把草地踩出窄道。
lines.en: Step by step I wear a narrow trail.

lines.zh: 树叶缝里漏下光，我眯眼。
lines.en: Light leaks through the leaves; I squint.

lines.zh: 我绕开落在地上的枝条。
lines.en: I step around a fallen branch.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，蹄子落得很稳。
lines.en: I walk slowly, my hooves landing sure.

lines.zh: 我从坡上下来，脚步收着。
lines.en: I come down the slope with short steps.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴身后，隔着几步。
lines.en: I follow a herdmate a few paces back.
I stop once and test the wind.
I cross a stretch of tall grass.

lines.zh: 我转过头，朝水声那边去。
lines.en: I turn toward the sound of water.

lines.zh: 我沿着水岸走，踩着碎石。
lines.en: I walk the bank, stepping over loose stones.
I step into the shallows and my hooves wet.
I walk along the bank.
I raise my head again to check the sky.
I stand with the crest tilted slightly forward.

lines.zh: 我把重心放在中间两条腿上。
lines.en: I rest my weight on the middle two legs.
I chew slowly, froth at my lips.

lines.zh: 风把我的冠脊吹得发响。
lines.en: The wind makes my crest hum.
I hold still and look far off.
I lift a hoof and set it down.

lines.zh: 我的六条腿摆得很对称。
lines.en: My six legs stand in neat symmetry.
I toss my head to drive off flies.
I listen to the sounds of the wood.

lines.zh: 我的冠脊在草地上投下影。
lines.en: My crest casts a shadow on the grass.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，声音很轻。
lines.en: I snort softly.

lines.zh: 冠脊上有一道浅浅的痕。
lines.en: There is a shallow groove on my crest.
I slowly take a new heading.
I bask with my eyes half closed.
I paw the soil with a forehoof.
I do nothing; I only wait.
I raise my head, crest toward you.
You stand a head shorter than I.
I take half a step closer.
I sniff toward you.

lines.zh: 你把身体转过来，我停住。
lines.en: You turn toward me and I stop.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，头是偏的。
lines.en: When I look at you, my head is tilted.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的腿上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my legs.
I neither retreat nor come near.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口气，草伏了一片。
lines.en: I snort and a patch of grass bows.
Even if you reach out, I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我低着头，看你脚边的草。
lines.en: I lower my head to the grass by your feet.

lines.zh: 我们这样对看了好一会儿。
lines.en: We watch each other a good while.
I bleat twice and give two steps.
That landed on my leg.
All six legs are trembling.
I duck my head and lower my crest.
Hurting, I am still upright.
I tuck into the grass.
Blood runs down the bone of my leg.
I bring my back up slowly.

lines.zh: 这一记我刻在冠脊纹上。
lines.en: I carve that in the ridges of my crest.
Six legs are still standing.
One sniff and I move over.

lines.zh: 你把草递高，我抬头去够。
lines.en: You raise the grass and I stretch up.
This handful is young and soft.
I chew it fine.
The leaves wobble; I wait for a steady hand.
Done, I lift my eyes to you.
I chew with my eyes sweeping the field.
You take three steps and I take three.
My snout is nearly at your hand.
A little more and I stay.
I curl the grass away with my lips.
A ring of green froth turns at my mouth.
When you move, I look up.
This mouthful will last a while.
Done, I lick my mouth clean.
You take a step and I match it.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我晃了晃。
lines.en: You hit my leg and I sway.
Six legs brace and I do not fall.
I shift half a step to let you pass.
I am shoved askew.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的冠脊，它响了。
lines.en: You strike my crest and it rings.
I lower my eyes across you.
This crowded, my legs cannot turn.
I back into the grass.
I am tired of being knocked about.
I plant a hoof right in front of you.
Two snouts meet.
It rubs my neck with its crest.
We walk abreast in matching steps.
I go once around it.

lines.zh: 它一动，我六条腿跟着动。
lines.en: It moves and all six legs follow.
We gnaw the same stem.
It strays and I bleat once.
Two bodies doze leaning together.
My chin presses on its spine.

lines.zh: 冠脊相碰，轻轻响了一下。
lines.en: Our crests touch with a light ring.
I take up a wisp of grass.
A press of the lips and the leaf rolls in.
This is too tough.
I dip and bite the stem through.
I pin it under a forehoof.
My mouth bulges full.
I spit it out; the taste is off.
I swallow it mouthful by mouthful.
This has soil on it, so I shake it.
Done, I look for the next clump.
The grass stirs and my crest comes up.

lines.zh: 我把那个轮廓收进眼里。
lines.en: I take that outline into my eye.

lines.zh: 我压低嗓子，同伴都竖耳。
lines.en: I call low and the herd's ears go up.
It is already far too near.

lines.zh: 我把冠脊压低，朝它对着。
lines.en: I lower my crest and point it.
The wind brings its smell.
I paw the soil.
I push in ahead of my herdmate.
Once locked, I stop grazing.
I shift half a step toward it.
My eyes stay stuck to it.
It loops and I twist my neck round.
I do not flee; fleeing costs more.
I give ground step by step into the grass.
It closes and I lower my crest.

lines.zh: 我抬起前蹄，准备落下去。
lines.en: I lift a forehoof, ready to bring it down.
Both sides are nailed in place.
It tries my back and I swivel first.
The muscles in my legs are taut.
One step more and I butt.
Head down, my crest arrives first.
I drive in with my shoulder rim.
My forehoof lands on its legs.
That butt drives it back.
I bite at its foot.
It swings down and I take it on the shoulder.
I butt again, heavier.
It draws off and I root my feet.
My crest draws a line on it.
When I stop I pant with my head low.

lines.zh: 我从林子里走出来，蹄声很轻。
lines.en: I come out of the wood, hooves light.
Six hooves land on the fallen leaves.
The grass is thick here.
I dip for a wisp of grass first.
Herdmates come from deeper in the wood.

lines.zh: 我把冠脊抬起来看了看。
lines.en: I lift my crest and look around.
There is water in the wind.
I walk toward the sound of water.
Out of the tree shade, I take my first step.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片空地走了一圈。
lines.en: I walk one circuit of the clearing.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的冠脊，我甩头躲。
lines.en: Fire catches my crest and I shake my head away.
All six legs take the landing at once.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻腔，我把头昂起。
lines.en: Water fills my nostrils and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀翻，蹄子在空中乱蹬。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my hooves churn air.

lines.zh: 一支东西钉进肩头，我扭头。
lines.en: Something pins my shoulder and I turn.
Chill seeps under my hide and I shudder.
Too hungry and my neck feels heavy.

lines.zh: 雷打在冠脊上，我全身都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my crest and numbs me all over.
There is no solid ground below.
